top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs sink into October outflows with $643M exit after Binance hack
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended October with $515 million in net withdrawals, while Ether funds posted a record $1.61 billion in monthly outflows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: South Africa’s Low-Key Municipal Polls Hold Risk for Markets
top_signals.summary: South Africa’s nationwide municipal elections on Wednesday hold few fears for investors, if market indicators are anything to go by. But shifts in broad support for the major political parties could provide a read on the future of the governing coalition that has steered the country’s fiscal and economic reforms.

top_signals.title: Ishiba underscores importance of National Disaster Management Agency
top_signals.summary: The agency must be made "capable of accumulating and passing on knowledge and experience" of disaster management, the former prime minister said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
